title: Life at IIT Bhilai (Physical Fitness & Lifestyle)
text:
LIFE AT IIT BHILAI
Along with a well-equipped and growing gym, the institute not only promotes the physical fitness of the students but also conducts many awareness programs, mental health workshops, and Newsletter Tuesdays focused on reducing academic stress and encouraging a healthy lifestyle.
Students are regularly made aware of the precautions to take during cold nights and extreme heat to avoid illness, reflecting the institute’s commitment towards their overall physical and mental well-being.
The mess provides the students with a well-rounded balanced diet, along with added provisions of commemorative feasts as well as religious fasting meals to cater to the diverse needs and traditions of the student community. Along with this, the institute has several cafes that serve as comfortable spaces for students to relax, socialize, and refresh themselves during their daily routine.
In essence, life at IIT Bhilai is far more than just an academic pursuit—it is a holistic journey of growth, discovery, and self-expression. Beyond classrooms and laboratories, students engage in cultural, technical, and recreational activities that help them develop leadership, teamwork, and interpersonal skills. The institute nurtures not just technically proficient engineers and scientists, but well-rounded individuals equipped with the curiosity, resilience, and creativity to make a meaningful impact on the world.
45

title: NSO: National Sports Organisation Overview & Disciplines
text:
GLIMPSE OF STUDENT ACTIVITIES
NSO :
The National Sports Organisation (NSO) offers a structured program that requires all enrolled first-year students to participate in sports and yoga, dedicating a portion of their time to physical wellness. Students select a sport of their choice, which helps them build discipline, teamwork, and a healthy lifestyle. This initiative cultivates a deep sense of passion and sportsmanship, encouraging students to explore interests beyond academics.
One of the major advantages of NSO is that it improves the physical health of students. Regular exercise and participation in sports helps students remain active, energetic, and healthy. Physical activities increase stamina, concentration, and reduce the chances of illness. In today’s busy academic life, sports also help students relieve stress and maintain mental stability and peace.
Moreover, NSO provides a dynamic platform for students to showcase their skills in various sports, including football, badminton, cricket, athletics, basketball, table tennis, yoga, aquatics, and more. Recreational games also form a part of the experience, making NSO a holistic approach to student development. Through regular training sessions and intra-college events, NSO helps instill values of resilience, focus and mutual respect that are essential both on and off the field.
46

title: NSS: National Service Scheme (Motive & Leadership)
text:
National Service Scheme
NSS
Lanka Devi Satwika - NSS Secretary
Motive
The National Service Scheme (NSS) is a Government of India initiative under the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports — and at IIT Bhilai, it's a movement. We are students who believe that engineering minds can solve more than technical problems. Through hands-on community service, social outreach, and grassroots engagement, we work alongside the communities surrounding IIT Bhilai to create meaningful, lasting change. NSS isn't just about giving back — it's about growing together. Our platform bridges student innovation with community wisdom, turning ideas into impact.
Objectives:
• To understand the community in which we work.
• To identify the needs and problems of the community and make a sincere attempt to solve the same.
• To develop among ourselves a sense of social and civic responsibility.
• To utilize our knowledge in finding practical solutions to individual and community problems.
• To develop competence required for group-living and sharing of responsibilities.
• To gain skills in mobilizing community participation, acquire leadership qualities and democratic attitudes develop capacity to meet emergencies and natural disasters.
• To practice national integration and social harmony.
48

title: NSS: National Service Scheme Activities & Initiatives
text:
GLIMPSE OF STUDENT ACTIVITIES
NSS :
“Serve the Society, Shape the Nation”
This powerful motto captures the essence of the National Service Scheme (NSS) at IIT Bhilai. The program is designed to nurture socially responsible and compassionate individuals with a deep commitment to civic duties and ethical leadership. The Students enrolled in NSS actively participate in various community-driven initiatives that encourage empathy, teamwork, and real-world engagement beyond academic life. Through a structured set of activities, NSS helps students grow into responsible citizens while making meaningful contributions to society.
49
The program frequently partners with local NGOs and organizes impactful events such as educational outreach visits to schools, blood donation drives, charity fundraisers, and environmental campaigns like tree plantations and cleanliness drives. NSS also helps students understand the real problems faced by society, by visiting villages and participating in social service activities and thus students gain practical knowledge about issues such as poverty, illiteracy, health, and environmental problems. This creates awareness and encourages students to contribute positively to society.

title: EBSB: Ek Bharat Shreshth Bharat
text:
GLIMPSE OF STUDENT ACTIVITIES
EBSB (EK BHARAT SHRESTH BHARAT)
LED BY ARUSHI RAWAT (EBSB Coordinator)
50
EBSB is a national initiative dedicated to celebrating the incredible cultural diversity of India. Behind every cultural event, outreach campaign, and storytelling initiative is a team working tirelessly (and sometimes chaotically!) to make it all happen.
EBSB is a platform that bridges states, traditions, and communities. Launched in 2015 by the Government of India, it is a flagship cultural integration program designed to celebrate the nation's diversity, promote mutual interaction, and strengthen emotional bonds between the people of different states and union territories.
From state pairing exchanges, folk dance and music showcases, ethnic nights, food festivals, celebration of festivals like Janmashtami, Onam, and language learning workshops to storytelling sessions and historical discussions, EBSB creates opportunities for students to connect with different traditions.

title: Prayatna: Flagship Annual Sports Tournament
text:
GLIMPSE OF STUDENT ACTIVITIES
PRAYATNA :
“Prayatna” is IIT Bhilai's flagship annual sports tournament and a highlight of student life on campus which generally occurs in 3 Phases. The word “Prayatna” itself means efforts or determination, which perfectly reflects the spirit of sportsmanship, teamwork, and hard work shown by the students during the event. It is a celebration of athletic spirit, where students from all academic years come together to compete and contribute to their teams with zeal and determination. This two-month-long extravaganza is packed with energy and enthusiasm, offering a perfect blend of competition and camaraderie.
The main attraction of Prayatna is the competition among eight different teams. Each team represents unity, dedication, and competitive spirit. The teams compete against one another in various sports—from indoor games like chess and table tennis to outdoor games such as football, volleyball, basketball, cricket, badminton, and athletics. Prayatna is more than just a sports fest — it brings people together, instilling a strong sense of community and pride among both participants and spectators.
It reflects IIT Bhilai’s dedication to shaping well-rounded individuals and embodies the relentless “Never Give Up” spirit of its students.
51

title: Anveshan: Flagship Cultural Championship
text:
GLIMPSE OF STUDENT ACTIVITIES
ANVESHAN :
“Anveshan” is IIT Bhilai’s flagship Intra-institute cultural championship and one of the most awaited events of the academic year. The word “Anveshan” means exploration or discovery, and the event truly reflects the discovery of creativity, talent, and artistic excellence among students. Held annually, it spans over two weeks and celebrates the artistic diversity and creativity of the student community.
Organized under the guidance of the Council of Student Affairs (CoSA), Anveshan features an exciting line-up of events from various cultural clubs including music, dance, drama, fine arts, photography, literature, and quizzes.
Each Day is themed around specific clubs, giving participants ample opportunity to compete, collaborate, and celebrate. Anveshan is not just a competition but also a platform for students to express their talents and creativity. It helps students build confidence, improve communication skills, and overcome stage fear. Students learn the importance of teamwork, discipline, leadership, and coordination while organizing and participating in different events.
52

title: Inter-IIT Meets (Sports, Sci-Tech, Cultural)
text:
INTER-IIT MEETS :
The Inter-IIT Meets are prestigious annual gatherings where students from all IITs come together to compete, collaborate, and celebrate excellence across three major domains — Science and Technology, Cultural, and Sports. Representing one’s institute at these PAN-India level meets is considered a mark of honor and pride. Students prepare for months to represent their IIT and compete with pride and dedication. Winning medals and trophies at Inter IIT is considered a great achievement and brings honor to the institute.
Each meet spans several days of intense competition, learning, and camaraderie. The Inter IIT event originally started as a sports competition known as the Inter IIT Sports Meet (cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, athletics, badminton, table tennis, hockey, chess, etc.). Over time, the event expanded to include technical and cultural competitions as well.
Every year, different IITs take turns hosting these meets: IIT Madras in collaboration with IIT Tirupati hosted the Sports Meet, IIT Kanpur welcomed participants for the Cultural Meet, and IIT Patna organized the Sci-Tech Meet.
53

title: Intra-College Events (Ciao, Cultscape, National Sports Week)
text:
INTRA-COLLEGE EVENTS :
IIT Bhilai’s intra-college events form a vibrant part of campus life, offering students diverse opportunities to explore their interests beyond academics.
Cultural activities are anchored by flagship events like Anveshan, a week-long cultural championship featuring competitions in music, dance, theater, art, and literature.
From Ciao, which welcomes freshers, to Cultscape, the grand cultural finale bidding farewell to seniors, these events reflect the vibrant spirit of the college.
Various clubs—including Swara (Music), Beathackers (Dance), Drishya (Drama), TPS (The Pixel Snappers), FPS (Film Production Society), and Quizzotica (Quiz)—host frequent events and workshops throughout the year.
On the sports front, Prayatna is the major intra-institute tournament, spanning several months and involving over 450 students across cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, chess, and athletics. The institute also celebrates National Sports Week with activities like tug of war, arm-wrestling, marathons, and chess tournaments.

title: Council of Student Affairs (CoSA) Overview & Structure
text:
COUNCIL OF STUDENT AFFAIRS (COSA)
CoSA, the Council of Student Affairs, comprises student representatives who promote holistic development at IIT Bhilai through various activities and facilitate communication of students’ concerns to the institute authorities.
The Council is led by the President and consists of General Secretaries of Academic, Science and Technology, Cultural and Media, Games and Sports, along with nominated members, the Events Head, the External Affairs head, and Treasurer. The Council is democratically elected by the students of IIT Bhilai, except for the nominated members selected by the President.
Normally, the members hold office from the day they are elected to the end of March. CoSA strives to create a culture of diversity and tradition, to provide opportunities for exploration in all sorts of hobbies, and maintains a liaison between institute administration and students.

CHESS (COORDINATOR: SHIVAM SHRIVASTAVA)
Dive into our vibrant and expanding chess culture. We provide year-round engagement through readily available chess boards and clocks, facilitating regular casual games, intensive practice sessions, training activities, and campus-wide tournaments.
Join our official Lichess online chess team, boasting over 180 members, where players of all skill levels connect through online tournaments, practice games, and team events.

title: Sports: Table Tennis Infrastructure & Hostels
text:
SPORTS AT IIT BHILAI
TABLE TENNIS (COORDINATORS: SARVESH AND SUMEDHA)
Experience our robust table tennis infrastructure accessible across the Gopad, Kanhar, and Indravati hostels. With two tables available in both Gopad and Kanhar, and three high-quality tables situated in Indravati, students enjoy ample space for recreational play and consistent skill development.
Indravati features a specialized professional environment, complete with professional-grade vinyl flooring mats and a table tennis robot dedicated to intensive Inter-IIT preparation. Meanwhile, Gopad and Kanhar offer superior playing conditions with well-maintained wooden flooring designed for a premium athletic experience.
To ensure top-tier performance, every hostel is outfitted with professional equipment, including four Stag 1 Star and two GKI Dragon rackets.

title: Sports: Gym & Fitness Centers (Mess & Hostels)
text:
SPORTS AT IIT BHILAI
GYM & FITNESS CENTERS (COORDINATORS: PRATYUSH SHRIVASTAVA AND RHIDAM JAIN)
Elevate your fitness journey at our primary gym facility located above the mess.
Our cardiovascular zone is fully equipped with modern treadmills, stationary bicycles, and rowing machines designed for high-endurance training and aerobic health.
For strength training, we offer a comprehensive suite of professional machines, including leg extension and curl stations, shoulder and leg presses, a hack squat machine, and a versatile Smith machine. Our strength floor also features dedicated cable stations, lat pulldowns, and equipment for dips and vertical knee raises.
Athletes can further refine their routines with our extensive range of free weights, featuring a complete set of dumbbells, standard and EZ barbells, and specialized deadlift platforms. We also provide flat and incline benches for chest training, preacher curl benches for isolation work, and high-quality yoga mats for flexibility and recovery.
Starting this year, we have expanded our fitness footprint by introducing dedicated workout spaces within all three campus hostels. These satellite facilities are curated with essential strength equipment, including Smith machines, cable stations, and a versatile selection of free weights to provide convenient training options for all residents.
